    Exact abelian subcategories of finite modules #

    structure EFiniteCharacterizations.IsExactAbelianClass {C : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] [CategoryTheory.Abelian C] (W : CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty C) :
    Prop

    A replete full subcategory containing zero and closed under binary sums, kernels and cokernels of maps between its objects.

    • zero_mem (X : C) : CategoryTheory.Limits.IsZero X → W X
    • iso_mem {X Y : C} : ∀ (a : X ≅ Y), W X → W Y
    • kernel_mem {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) : W X → W Y → W (CategoryTheory.Limits.kernel f)
    • cokernel_mem {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) : W X → W Y → W (CategoryTheory.Limits.cokernel f)
    • biprod_mem {X Y : C} : W X → W Y → W (X ⊞ Y)

      structure EFiniteCharacterizations.IsWideClass {C : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] [CategoryTheory.Abelian C] (W : CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty C) :
